prompt:
Create one continuous 10-second natural real-time smartphone fashion clip, vertical 9:16, native 1080p. [identity] Reference image 0 is the accepted opening keyframe and the sole visual identity, body, outfit, pose and location source—not loose inspiration. Preserve this exact adult woman's facial geometry in every frame: face outline, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose bridge and tip, lip proportions, skin tone, age, center-part long straight black hair, hairline, shoulder-waist-hip proportions and leg length. Never recast, beautify, change ethnicity, change hairstyle, slim, enlarge curves or lengthen limbs. [user] Preserve the exact garment color, neckline, seams, waistband, length and fit already embedded in the keyframe. No outfit transformation. [skill] Same corridor geometry, window, sculptures, floor, lighting direction, exposure and camera position throughout. Boyfriend-viewpoint candid phone shot at eye level, nearly fixed with only subtle human micro-jitter; no zoom, orbit, pan, tracking, low angle, cuts or transitions. Both feet must keep credible ground contact and contact shadows; no gliding, floating, foot sliding or continuous walking. Each time segment has one main action. Natural blinks, breathing, fine hair and cloth response only. She does not stare at the lens throughout. No second person or hand entering frame. No captions, watermark, brand text, dialogue or music; quiet corridor ambience and only action-related cloth/foot sounds. Avoid identity drift at head turns, anatomical distortion, extra/fused fingers, broken joints, garment mutation, background warping, sudden pose resets, plastic skin or glossy CGI.
[user] Outfit remains the exact grey sleeveless high-neck full-zip fitted athletic vest with curved chest and waist seam lines, black high-waist mid-thigh biker shorts, and white low-top sneakers. 0-1.5s: the forward foot finishes one short natural step and plants firmly; hips and torso settle over the new support leg, both shoe shadows lock to the floor. 1.5-4s: standing in place, right fingers smooth the vest hem once by two or three centimeters; zipper and seam lines stay fixed. 4-6.5s: right hand releases and rests naturally, head turns slightly toward the window while eyes follow. 6.5-8.5s: brief glance toward the companion just beside the lens with a restrained relaxed expression. 8.5-10s: gaze returns down the corridor and body settles. No additional step, runway sway, hem lifting, zipper opening or shorts deformation.
